text: The film version of Miss Shelagh Delaney's play A Taste of Honey opens at the Leicester Square Theatre tomorrow. It has been produced and directed by Mr. Tony Richardson, who is also part-author with Miss Delaney of the script, and the great advantages to be derived from this unity of conception and control are everywhere apparent. The film version of Miss Shelagh Debney's play A Taste of Honey Opens at the Leicester Square theatre tomorrow. It has been produced and directed by Mr.Tony Riclardson, who is also part-author with Miss Delaney of the script, and the great advantages to be derived from this unity of conception and control are everywhere apparent.
